meta.title: Preview printer
meta.description: Print from the right Sidebar document preview and rescue legacy files the preview cannot open. The toolbar offers a button per file type: PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT and PPTX get page selection and resolution through the Windows print dialog (pick a printer or Save as PDF), a copy of the same PDF beside the source, or Full-speed HD print that hands the vector PDF straight to the default printer; images are fitted to A4 and can be printed or exported as a one-page PDF; Markdown and txt/py/json/js/bat print as text (JSON re-indented, files over 2 MB or 5,000 lines refused). A damaged legacy DOC/PPT is padded, saved as a "-repaired" copy, and offered as an "Already repaired" chip next to the preview failure; an unreadable XLS is converted to XLSX for reading. Spreadsheets are never printed.
